Editor's restoration; ⲡⲓⲣⲏⲧⲉ ⲭⲉ 'in this manner, [saying]' is the standard idiom introducing reported speech in Lycopolitan, and the surviving -ⲧⲉ ⲭⲉ requires it.
Editor's restoration; the first-person perfect 'I came forth' opens the recited speech of each emanation in turn, paralleling the sequence ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉϩⲛⲟⲩⲥ etc. that follows.

Editor's restoration; ⲛ̄ⲭⲓ introduces the appositive identifying the speaker (the Third Ambassador) whose first-person utterance opens the enumeration of the Father's emanations from his five intellectual members.

Editor's restoration required by the fivefold faculty enumeration: mind → Beloved of Lights, thought → Mother of Life. The Coptic ⲙⲉⲩⲉ ('thought') is the second of the five faculties of the rational and matches the sequence exactly.

The title of the entity emanating from teaching (ⲥⲃⲱ) is genuinely lost; est. 4 chars allows several candidates (ⲡⲣⲏ, ⲡⲣⲓⲉ, ⲓ̄ⲏ̄ⲥ̄, abbreviated ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ) but the manuscript pattern in this Kephalaion does not constrain the choice tightly enough to fix the title. Honest non-restoration preferred.
Editor's restoration completing ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ ('Light') across the line break and beginning ⲁⲃⲁⲗ for the next clause 'from his reflection,' carried into section 1592.
Editor's restoration. The form ⲡⲓϯⲟⲩ ('the Five') modifies the following ⲛⲓⲱⲧ ('Fathers'), and the preceding -ⲉ closes the verbal form ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲧⲱϩⲙ̄(ⲉ).
Editor's restoration; the standard formula ⲡⲓϯⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲱⲧ ('the Five Members of the Father') is required, with ⲁ- starting ⲁⲃⲁⲗ for the next clause 'one came forth from another'.

english_segments.core_english: {0} the Father, one beside another. {1} in this manner: '{2}
{3} from his mind, the Beloved of the Lights;
{4} the Mother of Life; from his teaching, {5};
the Beloved; from his counsel, the Virgin of Light; {6}
from his reflection.' Thus then is the manner in which they were called forth, {7}
Fathers — in this coming they came forth from the Five Members {8}

english_restorations.basis: Direct rendering of ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲙ̄- 'from,' opening the governing formula of the whole enumeration.
ⲡⲓⲣⲏⲧⲉ ⲭⲉ is the idiomatic 'this is the manner [in which]: saying' — supplied as 'It is in this manner: [saying],' translating the cleft construction.
First-person perfect ⲁϩⲉⲓ, the recited self-naming with which each emanation introduces itself.
ⲛ̄ⲭⲓ ⲡⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ — the appositive identifying the Third Ambassador as the speaker of the recited enumeration; lexicon entry 'Third Ambassador' = ⲡⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ.
ⲙⲉⲩⲉ is the second of the five faculties (lexicon: 'thought / the movement of mind toward what it considers'). The fivefold parallel demands this rendering.
The Coptic title is lost and not constrained tightly enough to fix the English equivalent. Honest non-restoration.
Renders the ⲁ- of ⲁⲃⲁⲗ that begins the 'from his reflection' phrase carried into the next segment.
ⲛ̄ϭⲓ ⲡⲓϯⲟⲩ — the appositive 'namely the Five [Fathers]' introducing the summary phrase that gathers the five emanations.
The standard formula 'Five Members of the Father' (ⲡⲓϯⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲱⲧ); the ⲁ- of the next ⲁⲃⲁⲗ is absorbed into the following segment's 'one came forth from another.'

restoration_note: This teaching describes the Lord's outgoing in five — the standard Kephalaia schema of the Father's five intellectual faculties (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection) each emanating a divine principle in ordered succession 'one beside another.' The fivefold parallel structure tightly constrains gaps 0, 1, 4, 6, 7, 8: the formulaic 'ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉϩ-X' phrasing and the standard formula 'Five Members of the Father' are recoverable with high confidence. Gap 2 (the first-person 'I came forth') and gap 3 (the Ambassador as speaker) follow the editor's reading of the recited enumeration. Gap 5 — the title of the entity emanating from 'teaching' (ⲥⲃⲱ) — is genuinely lost: the est. 4 characters could fit several candidates (ⲡⲣⲏ, ⲡⲣⲓⲉ, ⲓ̄ⲏ̄ⲥ̄, an abbreviated form), but the local context does not narrow the choice, so it is left unrestorable. The principle being articulated is the ordered procession of the divine outgoing, where each register — Beloved of the Lights, Mother of Life, [lost], Virgin of Light, [the fifth implied] — is held distinct from the others, mirroring the rational's five faculties so that influx is received without collapse or mingling.
